{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "max_tokens": 8000, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Emergency department visits and wait times at three metro hospitals, Jan-Jun 2024

The county health department compiled per-visit records from three hospitals for January through June 2024 to assess a new triage diversion policy.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `cost` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `day_of_week` | category | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `department` | category | Internal Medicine, Surgery, Pediatrics, Trauma; within hospital; group entity |
| `hospital` | category | Mercy General, St. Luke's, Riverside; group entity |
| `month` | category | 2024-01, 2024-02, 2024-03, 2024-04, 2024-05, 2024-06; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `quarter` | category | 2024-Q1, 2024-Q2; ordered=ordinal; derived from visit_date; group calendar |
| `satisfaction` | measure | unit points; non-additive |
| `severity` | category | Minor, Moderate, Severe; ordered=ordinal; group triage |
| `visit_date` | time | 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30, daily; group calendar |
| `wait_minutes` | measure | unit minutes; additive |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Which hospital and department waits longest
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by visit_date, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads visit_date off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How wait time moved over the half year
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(wait_minutes, satisfaction), unit minutes, points
    drawn to answer: Do longer waits go with lower satisfaction
- `f04`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p1: grouped_bar, grouped by hospital, department, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p1 reads hospital off the axis tick, department off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f05`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p0 is titled '2024-01-01 to 2024-03-31'
    p1: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p1 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p1 is titled '2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f06`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p1: bar, grouped by hospital, SUM(cost), unit USD
    p1 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: dual_metric
- `f07`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f08`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    p0: error_bar, grouped by hospital, FIVE_NUM(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_range
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    its subtitle is already fixed as '2024-01-01 to 2024-03-31'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f10`
    p0: bar, grouped by hospital, AVG(wait_minutes), unit minutes
    p0 reads hospital off the axis tick
    its subtitle is already fixed as '2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f11`
    p0: pie, grouped by day_of_week, AVG(cost), unit USD
    p0 reads day_of_week off the inline label
- `f12`
    p0: table_chart, grouped by day_of_week, quarter, AVG(satisfaction), unit points
    p0 reads day_of_week off the inline label, quarter off the inline label
- `f13`
    p0: bar, grouped by month, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads month off the axis tick
- `f14`
    p0: area, grouped by visit_date, severity, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads visit_date off the axis tick, severity off the legend
- `f15`
    p0: heatmap, grouped by department, hospital, SUM(cost), unit USD
    p0 reads department off the axis tick, hospital off the axis tick
- `f16`
    p0: range_bar, grouped by day_of_week, FIVE_NUM(cost), unit USD
    p0 reads day_of_week off the axis tick

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| `title` | What the figure shows. Name the quantity and how it is broken down |
| `subtitle` | The qualifier: what each mark covers, over what period |
| `unit` | The unit the values are in, as it would be written on an axis |
| `column_names` | One readable name per column below, used on axes and in legends |
